text:
sam: :rotating_light: seeing a new 429 spike from a mid-market org since ~09:12 UTC, CS is getting paged. spike looks bursty, not sustained.

anya: saw the alerts. user reports latency + repeated client retries. they hit 429s on both chat and embeddings endpoints.

lee: digging into Grafana now. initial panel shows a sharp rise in per-key 429 rate around 09:10 and a smaller burst at 08:50 earlier. attaching prom query i used:```promql
sum by (org_id, api_key) (increase(api_responses_total{code="429"}[5m])) /
sum by (org_id, api_key) (increase(api_requests_total[5m])) * 100
```

josh: do we already have per-key burst protection that triggers a temporary throttle before quota exhaustion? last time we relied on quota window smoothing and it was too slow.

sam: current enforcement is per-key token-rate + per-org monthly commit. bursts fall through if short-lived. we do have short-term burst allowance but config defaults are aggressive for PLG keys.

maria: CS asks for an "early warning" they can see on the console before pages. can we add a 5m rolling 429% alert that goes to CS as a low-pri banner?

lee: propose creating an "anomaly signal" alert rule (severity: info) that fires when: per-key 429_rate_pct_5m > 2% AND requests_p95 > baseline*1.5. example rule snippet:```yaml
alert: Early429Anomaly
expr: |
  (sum by (api_key) (increase(api_responses_total{code="429"}[5m])) / sum by (api_key) (increase(api_requests_total[5m]))) > 0.02
  and
  (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(api_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, api_key)) > (api_request_duration_baseline_p95 * 1.5))
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: info
annotations:
  runbook: >
    https://redwood.internal/runbooks/429-anomaly
```

anya: that would help CS triage faster. please add a visible console banner too — product wants to avoid surprise pages if it's just a transient burst.

josh: agree. operational plan:
- lee: add the info-level alert in Grafana/Prometheus (2m for dedupe)
- sam: tweak burst throttling config to add an intermediate throttle bucket for short bursts (10s-2m) for PLG keys
- maria: expose a console warning panel for keys/orgs with rolling 429_rate_pct_5m > 1%
- anya: update the CS playbook with the new signal and banner behavior

sam: quick note on throttling: we can implement a leaky-bucket micro-throttle at edge (nginx/ingress) that returns a soft 429 with header X-Redwood-Retry-After and a hint when configured. makes it explicit to clients.

lee: will add a dedicated dashboard panel showing: per-key 429_rate_1m, 429_rate_5m, request_p95, and burst_token_pool level. panel will be pinned to the org view.

maria: UX ask — add a small timeline on the console banner that links to the dashboard window of the last 30m. keeps CS in the flow.

anya: will draft updated support steps: initial checks, look at dashboard, optionally hit "suppress pages" for 10m if signal is info-level and org is expected to be testing. need approval from eng-sre for suppress behavior.

sam: approve suppress toggle for info-level anomalies only. for severity:warning or higher, pages remain.

josh: creating a short RFC for the micro-throttle and alert flow. tagging @oncall when implemented.

alert-bot: Incident Alert: 429_Spike_Detected org=acme-corp severity=info first_seen=1799991111

lee: FYI — quick prom query to surface candidate keys for the dashboard (run in explore):```promql
topk(20, (increase(api_responses_total{code="429"}[5m]) / increase(api_requests_total[5m])) )
```

sam: action items summarized: 1) lee add info-alert + dashboard panel (due EOD) 2) sam implement micro-throttle template (PR) 3) maria add console banner + link (design + small prod change) 4) anya update CS playbook + suppression rules. I'll own rollout coordination.

maria: thanks — please @maria when PRs are ready so design can review the copy for the banner.

anya: copying the current playbook snippet here for reference: ```text
- On 429 spike: check per-key 5m 429 rate >1%
- If info-level anomaly: post console banner, advise client to check retries
- If warning-level or sustained: escalate to eng-sre and consider temporary capacity bump
```

josh: cool. if anyone sees this turn into sustained >5% across org for >10m, escalate immediately and create an incident channel. :eyes:
